review_method: Independent original-map pixels, complete source and baseline-rendered ring plots, registered outline/filled overlays, wider context and imprints. All 120 ordered positions across three single-ring Polygons were independently compared with original source geometry, decoded geometry and exact original inventory/core/detail joins. The full original WSA affine was reopened for all 120 registrations, Cumberland for 30 and the rotated Manitoba affine for 34, including both rotation terms. Three successful original receipts and all five inspected crop pixel arrays were reverified against fresh original PDF renders. Full geometry inspection is complete for all three, but Alberta-side source coverage is missing for the third; only two full-feature source correspondence reviews are complete. First observations and refinements preceded comparison with separate findings. The production decoder was not independently replayed by this reviewer.
counted_unit: Distinct logical inventory lake target IDs; repeated map labels do not increase the target count.
